SELECT 'Disk' AS metric,
  LEAST(
    CASE
      WHEN r.slope <= 0 THEN 9999
      WHEN t.disk_total_gb <= 0 THEN 9999
      ELSE GREATEST(0, ROUND(
        ((t.disk_total_gb - r.intercept) / r.slope - (extract(epoch FROM NOW()) / 86400))::numeric, 0
      ))
    END,
    9999
  ) AS "Days Until Full"
FROM (
  SELECT device_id,
    COALESCE(regr_slope(avg_used, day_num), 0::double precision) AS slope,
    COALESCE(regr_intercept(avg_used, day_num), 0::double precision) AS intercept
  FROM (
    SELECT device_id,
      AVG(avg_disk_used) AS avg_used,
      extract(epoch FROM time_bucket('1 day', bucket)) / 86400 AS day_num
    FROM public.sys_hourly
    WHERE bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    GROUP BY device_id, time_bucket('1 day', bucket)
  ) d
  GROUP BY device_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7
) r
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id) device_id, disk_total_gb
  FROM public.sys_metrics
  WHERE disk_total_gb > 0
  ORDER BY device_id, time DESC
) t ON t.device_id = r.device_id
ORDER BY 1 ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH historical AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('1 day', bucket) AS time,
    device_id,
    AVG(avg_disk_used) AS value,
    'History' AS metric
  FROM public.sys_hourly
  WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
    AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
    AND avg_disk_used >= 0
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
regression AS (
  SELECT
    device_id,
    COALESCE(regr_slope(avg_used, day_num), 0::double precision) AS slope,
    COALESCE(regr_intercept(avg_used, day_num), 0::double precision) AS intercept
  FROM (
    SELECT device_id,
      AVG(avg_disk_used) AS avg_used,
      extract(epoch FROM time_bucket('1 day', bucket)) / 86400 AS day_num
    FROM public.sys_hourly
    WHERE bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
    GROUP BY device_id, time_bucket('1 day', bucket)
  ) d
  GROUP BY device_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7
),
future_points AS (
  SELECT
    gs AS time,
    r.device_id,
    'Forecast' AS metric,
    GREATEST(0, ROUND(
      (r.slope * (extract(epoch FROM gs) / 86400) + r.intercept)::numeric, 2
    )) AS value
  FROM regression r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    (SELECT MAX(time) FROM historical) + INTERVAL '1 day',
    (SELECT MAX(time) FROM historical) + INTERVAL '30 days',
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  ) gs
  WHERE r.slope > 0
)
SELECT bucket AS time, device_id, value, metric FROM historical
UNION ALL
SELECT bucket AS time, device_id, value, metric FROM future_points
ORDER BY time ASC

panel: Machine PE Capability - Cp vs Cpk
sql:
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring})
    AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS stddev_pe, AVG(pe_setting) AS pe_limit
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, mean_pe, stddev_pe, pe_limit / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0) AS cp,
    LEAST((pe_limit - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0), (mean_pe + pe_limit) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0)) AS cpk
  FROM stats
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", ROUND(cp::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cp", ROUND(cpk::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cpk"
FROM capability ORDER BY cpk DESC NULLS LAST;
